map.鱼苗运输成活率估算：输入水温、实测溶氧、运输密度与时长，先算该温度下的饱和溶氧与: Fry transport survival estimator: enter water temperature, measured dissolved oxygen, transport density and duration. It first computes saturated DO and percent saturation at that temperature, then gives an empirical multiplicative survival estimate, making clear where estimates end and actual counts begin. Runs fully in your browser; no data is uploaded and no sign-up is required.

map.饱和溶氧 ≈ 14.652 − 0.41022T + 0.007991T² −: Saturated DO ≈ 14.652 − 0.41022T + 0.007991T² − 0.000077774T³; saturation = measured DO ÷ saturated DO × 100%; survival estimate = 100 × fO₂ × fD × fT, where fO₂ = min(1, saturation/100), fD = e^(−0.03 × density), fT = e^(−0.015 × duration). Validation: when temperature is outside 0–40℃, measured DO is negative, or density or duration is ≤ 0, the page shows a hint and outputs nothing.
map.成活率是「溶氧充足度 × 密度惩罚 × 时长惩罚」的经验乘法模型：溶氧越低、密度: Survival is an empirical multiplicative model of oxygen adequacy × density penalty × duration penalty: lower DO, higher density and longer trips all lower the estimate. It is not an actual count and only serves to compare transport plans.
map.成活率是经验模型估算值，不是实测计数；真实成活率须以装运前后抽样计数为准。饱和溶: Survival is an empirical estimate, not an actual count; the true rate must come from sampling counts before and after transport. Saturated DO is estimated from the temperature formula; measured values come from a DO meter.
map.水温需在 0–40℃、实测溶氧 ≥ 0、密度与时长均需大于 0: Water temperature must be 0–40℃, dissolved oxygen ≥ 0, and density and duration both greater than 0.
map.💡 公式提示：饱和度 = 实测溶氧 ÷ 该温度饱和溶氧 ×100%；成活率估算: 💡 Formula note: saturation = measured DO ÷ saturated DO at that temperature ×100%; survival estimate = 100 × fO₂ × e^(−0.03×density) × e^(−0.015×duration).
map.按运输水温算该温度下的饱和溶氧，再由实测溶氧得到饱和度。: Compute saturated DO at the transport temperature, then derive saturation from the measured DO.
map.把密度与时长纳入模型，比较不同装运方案下的成活率估算值。: Bring density and duration into the model to compare survival estimates across loading plans.
map.高温、长途、高密度三种条件下快速看出哪个因素在拖低成活率。: See at a glance which factor — heat, long trips or high density — is dragging survival down.
map.饱和溶氧约 8.18 mg/L，饱和度 6.5 / 8.18 ≈ 79.5%；f: Saturated DO is about 8.18 mg/L and saturation 6.5 / 8.18 ≈ 79.5%; fO₂ = 0.795, fD = e^(−0.3) ≈ 0.741, fT = e^(−0.09) ≈ 0.914; survival ≈ 100 × 0.795 × 0.741 × 0.914 ≈ 53.8%, with density as the limiting factor.
map.估算成活率能直接当作实测结果吗？: Can the estimate be used as an actual result?
map.不能。它是「溶氧充足度 × 密度惩罚 × 时长惩罚」的经验模型，只用于方案比较；: No. It is an empirical model of oxygen adequacy × density penalty × duration penalty, useful only for comparing plans; the true rate must come from sampling counts before and after transport.
map.为什么密度的影响这么大？: Why does density matter so much?
map.密度越高，单位水体耗氧与氨氮累积越快，模型按 e^(−0.03×密度) 递减；高: Higher density means faster oxygen consumption and ammonia accumulation per unit water, modeled as e^(−0.03×density); heat and long trips compound the effect.

map.水温 25℃、实测溶氧 6.5 mg/L：该温度饱和溶氧约 8.18 mg/L，: At 25℃ with measured DO 6.5 mg/L: the saturated DO at that temperature is about 8.18 mg/L, so saturation = 6.5 / 8.18 × 100% ≈ 79.5%, an acceptable range; it tends to keep falling at night and before dawn, so keep watching.
map.饱和溶氧随温度怎么变？: How does saturated dissolved oxygen change with temperature?
map.随水温升高而下降（气体溶解度降低），因此夏季高温时更易缺氧，须加强增氧与巡塘。: It falls as water temperature rises (gas solubility decreases), so hypoxia is more likely in hot summer weather — strengthen oxygenation and pond patrols.
map.一般要求 ≥5 mg/L、饱和度尽量≥70%~80%；凌晨与高密度时是最易缺氧时: Generally ≥5 mg/L is required and saturation should be ≥70%–80%; before dawn and at high density are the most hypoxia-prone periods, so leave margin.
